pinned_tolerances.rule: pinned: 3 x (engine step term + reference term + rounding term), per compared quantity and record, maximum over the records

amendments.text: Records: the frozen definitions declare record times as decimals (round(0.1 k, 10)); the engine observes only accepted boundaries, the float products k * dt. Each record is taken at its own boundary int(round(t / dt)) * dt (a shift below 1e-16 s) and compared with the prediction at t (cell_replacement_qualification.at_dt).

Pinning provenance: the dt study (qualification/dtstudy-02) ran at 15b5f7d, clean. The reference-term run (qualification/refterm-01) launched at 5fc5651 and records 15b5f7d, its HEAD when written; the one commit between them changes only the dt study's record mapping (A1), not the references. No engine output was compared with the frozen predictions before pinning.

Q5 estimator and cases. The full-size dry run on non-registered inputs (qualification/dryrun-01) gave registered-estimator orders 1.67 (W7 short-lag) and 2.95 (C9 donor short-lag). The order diagnosis on those inputs (qualification/q5-diagnosis, dt 4 to 0.25 ms) shows W7's successive-difference order rising 0.64, 1.67, 2.05 at h = 2, 1, 0.5 ms: second order, but asymptotic only below 1 ms. C9 donor's step error is at most 1e-9 V (no transient: a D copy among D neighbours), so its estimate is noise (2.2, 2.9, 4.5). C9 isolated short-lag gives 1.89, 2.06, 2.07. A3 therefore uses dt 2, 1, 0.5, 0.25 ms, the finest successive-difference ratio, and C9 isolated short-lag in place of C9 donor short-lag; the window is unchanged. Decided on non-registered inputs only; the registered cases were not run.
